objects.description: One unit of work a person or an agent is accountable for: what is to be done, who holds it, what state it is in, and what it waits on.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The short human-readable label, distinct from the description.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What doing this task actually involves, in prose.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where the task sits in its lifecycle. Every new task lands pending; completed and cancelled are terminal.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Relative urgency, used to order a queue rather than to gate anything.

fields.name: due_at
fields.description: The deadline. Empty when there is none.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: The labels attached to this task, denormalised from the tagging rows so a listing never joins. The tagging rows remain the authority.

fields.name: estimated_hours
fields.description: Planned effort to complete the task, in hours. Zero means unestimated.

fields.name: context
fields.description: The working memory an agent carries between attempts at this task.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.description: When the task reached a terminal status.

fields.name: task_name
fields.description: The project-scoped human-readable identifier minted at creation, such as MVP-001. Empty for a task in no project.

fields.name: project_name
fields.description: The slug of the project this task belongs to, denormalised so a read need not traverse the membership rows.

fields.name: separate_branch
fields.description: Whether work on this task is isolated on a line of its own rather than done in place.

fields.name: branch_name
fields.description: The name of that isolated line of work, when there is one.

fields.name: assigned_to
fields.description: The worker currently responsible for this task. Empty means unassigned.

fields.name: workflow_run_id
fields.description: The run this task belongs to, denormalised so a run's closure is one query.

fields.name: recovery_runs_used
fields.description: How many automatic retry cycles have already been charged against this task's recovery budget.

fields.name: blocker_note
fields.description: Why this task was held, written by whoever held it.

fields.name: direction_history
fields.description: The directions already given for this task, as a JSON-encoded list, so a reviewer can see what was tried.

fields.name: parent_task_id
fields.description: The task that was split to produce this one. Empty for a root task.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every read.

indexes.name: status
indexes.description: Filters the queue by lifecycle state, which is every listing's first narrowing.

indexes.name: assigned_to
indexes.description: Finds one worker's open tasks.

indexes.name: workflow_run
indexes.description: Reads one run's closure and resets it on rollback.

indexes.name: parent_task
indexes.description: Rolls a split task's children up to their parent.

objects.description: One ordered step a task was decomposed into. A step is dispatched on its own and may run beside its siblings when nothing precedes it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier minted once at creation, such as TD-1. It never changes, even when the title is later edited.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The short label for this step.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What this step is for.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: What the worker executing this step is told to do.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: The 1-based position of this step within its decomposition.

fields.name: can_run_parallel
fields.description: True when nothing precedes this step, so it may be dispatched beside its siblings.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.description: The ordinalities of the steps that must finish before this one is dispatched.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where this step sits in its lifecycle. Skipped is terminal and does not fail the parent.

fields.name: parent_task_id
fields.description: The task this step was decomposed from.

fields.name: decomp_run_id
fields.description: The agent run that produced this step.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The worker assigned to execute this step.

fields.name: precalls
fields.description: The fetches to perform before this step runs, as a JSON-encoded list.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: workflow_run_id
fields.description: The run this step belongs to, inherited from the parent task at creation.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete, set by a run's rollback cleanup. A deleted row is invisible to every read.

indexes.name: parent_task
indexes.description: Reads one task's decomposition in order.

indexes.name: workflow_run
indexes.description: Reads one run's closure and soft-deletes it on rollback.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Resolves a step by the code a person quotes.

objects.description: A worker that tasks are assigned to and that reports back. At most one row per external identifier, which is what lets an assignment find-or-create.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The worker's identifier in whatever system runs it. Unique, and the key an upsert matches on.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: A human-readable label for the worker.

fields.name: capability
fields.description: What this worker is for, such as code or research. Used to route a task to something that can do it.

fields.name: role_name
fields.description: The role this worker fulfils, used as a stable filter key when matching an event to a worker.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

indexes.name: agent_id
indexes.description: Finds a worker by its external identifier, which every upsert and assignment does first.

objects.description: A container that groups related tasks — a sprint, a milestone, an epic. Membership is many-to-many, so a task may sit in several.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The short human-readable label.

fields.name: project_name
fields.description: The URL-safe key derived from the name, and what a task's denormalised project_name holds.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What this grouping is for.

fields.name: repo_name
fields.description: The working store this project's files are read from, when it has one.

fields.name: github_repo
fields.description: The canonical upstream store, as owner/name, when it has one.

fields.name: task_prefix
fields.description: What a task name minted in this project is prefixed with. Empty falls back to the project key and a hyphen.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every read.

indexes.name: project_name
indexes.description: Resolves the key a task carries back to the project that minted it.

objects.description: A free-form label attachable to any number of tasks. Unique by name.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier minted once at creation, such as TG-1. It never changes, even when the name is later edited.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The label text. Unique, and what an upsert matches on.

fields.name: color
fields.description: A colour hint for whatever renders the label.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What this label means, so two people do not use it for two things.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

indexes.name: name
indexes.description: Finds a label by text, which every upsert does first.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Resolves a label by the code a person quotes.

objects.description: Something a task or one of its steps must produce. A definition and nothing more — it carries no runtime state of its own.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier minted once at creation, such as D-1. It never changes, even when the title is later edited.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The short label for what must be produced.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What producing this actually means.

fields.name: deliverable_type
fields.description: What kind of thing this is, so a reviewer knows how to check it.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: The task or step that owes this. Polymorphic, so it is not a foreign key.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: The 1-based position within the owner's deliverables.

fields.name: workflow_run_id
fields.description: The run this belongs to, inherited from the owner at creation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

indexes.name: parent
indexes.description: Reads one owner's deliverables in order.

indexes.name: workflow_run
indexes.description: Reads one run's closure.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Resolves a deliverable by the code a person quotes.

objects.description: A verifiable condition that must hold before the task or step owning it counts as done. A reviewer writes the outcome against it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier minted once at creation, such as AC-1. It never changes, even when the title is later edited.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The condition, stated so that it can be checked.

fields.name: description
fields.description: How to check it, where the title is not enough.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: The task or step this condition is on. Polymorphic, so it is not a foreign key.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: The 1-based position within the owner's criteria.

fields.name: workflow_run_id
fields.description: The run this belongs to, inherited from the owner at creation.

fields.name: result
fields.description: What the reviewer found. Empty until the review runs, which is why it carries no default.

fields.name: result_notes
fields.description: What the reviewer saw, in their own words.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

indexes.name: parent
indexes.description: Reads one owner's criteria in order.

indexes.name: workflow_run
indexes.description: Reads one run's closure.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Resolves a criterion by the code a person quotes.

objects.description: The anchor of one orchestrated execution: everything it produced hangs off it, and rolling it back is what undoes the whole of it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The human-readable label for this run. Unique across every run.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where the run sits in its lifecycle. Paused is a hold rather than an end; rolled_back is where a compensated run finishes.

fields.name: trigger_event
fields.description: What started the run.

fields.name: initiator
fields.description: Who or what asked for it. Opaque to this module.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Anything worth recording about the run that no other field holds.

fields.name: agent_run_ids
fields.description: The worker runs linked to this run, as opaque identifiers, so a rollback knows what to compensate.

fields.name: function_job_ids
fields.description: The jobs linked to this run, as opaque identifiers.

fields.name: branch_names
fields.description: The isolated lines of work linked to this run.

fields.name: terminal_event
fields.description: The condition that, when an inbound event matches it, finishes the run on its own.

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: When the run first began executing.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.description: When the run reached a terminal status.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: parent_workflow_run_id
fields.description: The run whose failure spawned this recovery run. Empty on a top-level run.

fields.name: root_workflow_run_id
fields.description: The top of this run's chain, denormalised so the shared budget is read and charged in one query.

fields.name: failure_pipeline_budget
fields.description: How many recovery activations this lineage is allowed. Meaningful only on the root run.

fields.name: failure_pipelines_used
fields.description: How many recovery activations have been charged to this root run.

fields.name: counted_child_run_ids
fields.description: The child runs already charged to the budget, so charging the same one twice is a no-op.

fields.name: cancelled_by
fields.description: Who issued the cancel.

fields.name: cancel_reason
fields.description: Why they cancelled it.

fields.name: cancelling_until
fields.description: The deadline by which in-flight work must quiesce before the run is declared cancelled.

fields.name: last_event_at
fields.description: When an event last arrived carrying this run. What the watchdog sweeps on.

fields.name: timeout_published
fields.description: Whether a timeout was already announced for this run, so it is announced once.

fields.name: paused_at
fields.description: When the run was held. Non-empty suspends the watchdog for it.

fields.name: current_step_id
fields.description: The step currently executing, by its plan code.

fields.name: current_step_started_at
fields.description: When the current step began.

fields.name: failure_reason
fields.description: What went wrong, written when the run fails or its rollback does. Written for whoever reads the row outside this module.

indexes.name: name
indexes.description: Resolves a run by the label a caller quotes, and is what makes the label unique.

indexes.name: status
indexes.description: Finds the runs still in flight.

indexes.name: parent_workflow_run
indexes.description: Walks a recovery chain down from a failed run.

indexes.name: root_workflow_run
indexes.description: Reads a whole lineage, which the budget is accounted across.

indexes.name: last_event_at
indexes.description: The watchdog's sweep, which reads every run quiet for too long.

objects.description: One asynchronous import of a project and its tasks, and what it has managed so far. Its own row so a caller can ask after it once the request that started it has returned.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where the import sits in its lifecycle.

fields.name: error_message
fields.description: Why the import failed. Empty unless it did.

fields.name: progress_steps
fields.description: What the import has done so far, a line at a time, so a caller can watch it rather than wait blind.

fields.name: tasks_created
fields.description: How many tasks the import created. Meaningful once it completes.

fields.name: deps_created
fields.description: How many dependency edges the import wrote. Meaningful once it completes.

fields.name: project_name
fields.description: The project the import created. Meaningful once it completes.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the row was last written.

indexes.name: status
indexes.description: Finds the imports still running, which a restart has to reconcile.

objects.description: A hard gate between two tasks: the source must reach a terminal status before the target may start. Many-to-many, so it is a row rather than a column.

fields.name: from_task_id
fields.description: The task that must finish first.

fields.name: to_task_id
fields.description: The task held until it does.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the gate was put in place.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why one waits on the other.

indexes.name: to_task
indexes.description: Answers what is holding this task, which every dispatch check asks.

objects.description: A soft ordering between two tasks: informational, with no gate of its own. Many-to-many, so it is a row rather than a column.

fields.name: from_task_id
fields.description: The task that depends.

fields.name: to_task_id
fields.description: The task depended on.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the dependency was recorded.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why one follows the other.

indexes.name: to_task
indexes.description: Answers what depends on this task, which a completion has to sweep.

objects.description: Records that one task belongs to one project. Many-to-many: a task may sit in several.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: The task that belongs.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: The project it belongs to.

fields.name: added_at
fields.description: When it was added.

indexes.name: project
indexes.description: Reads one project's tasks.

objects.description: Records that one label is attached to one task. Many-to-many, and the authority behind a task's denormalised tags.

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: The task labelled.

fields.name: tag_id
fields.description: The label attached.

fields.name: tagged_at
fields.description: When it was attached.

indexes.name: tag
indexes.description: Reads every task carrying one label.

objects.description: The next number to mint for one kind of thing's stable code, one row per kind. Separate from the things it numbers so the counter can be read and advanced without touching them.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: The kind of thing being numbered, such as deliverable or tag.

fields.name: next_number
fields.description: The number the next code for that kind will carry.
